title: Global universality of the expected number of zeros of non-analytic random signals
summary: We study the asymptotics as $n$ goes to infinity of $\mathbb E\left[\mathcal{N}(S_n,[0,2π])\right]$, the expected number of zeros in $[0, 2π]$ of a random periodic signal $S_n$ of the form \[ S_n(t)=\sum_{k=1}^{n}a_k f(kt), \] where $f$ is a non-analytic $2π-$periodic function and the coefficients $(a_k)$ are i.i.d. random variables, centered with unit variance.
